fields.why: Table 2 compares proportions across 3 age groups by chi-square, and Table 1 tests period by age (3) and race/ethnicity (6 levels) with one p-value per variable.
Age and race/ethnicity are margins of the chi-square tests (rule 2/6); sex has 2 levels.

Chi-square tests are omnibus; the 'highest rates' claim for <6 months rests on age-specific hospitalization rates with no test across age groups, so side by side; the mechanical flag is a false alarm (different results).
